text:
anya: Quick note from today's huddle: proposing 'reserve ladder'—three commitment bands, explicit burst credits, and a short onboarding prewarm. capturing tradeoffs here.
mike: can you list exact bands and what customer gets at each?
anya: draft bands: Band Bronze: 8 GPUs baseline + 40% burst credit. Band Silver: 24 GPUs baseline + 25% burst. Band Gold: 80 GPUs baseline + 15% burst.
tereza: sales needs simple customer-facing bullets and a sample invoice row. procurement will want numbers.
anya: billing rules: burst consumed before overage; overage billed at premium; 48h soft-proration window on tier changes; no automatic refunds.
mike: infra concerns: burst tracked as "gpu-minutes" ledger per-tenant per-region. allow cross-region borrow with a penalty flag.
oliver: autoscale policy: within burst -> instant scale up; after burst -> cap at baseline and route excess to shared pool with degraded model variant. downscale cooldown 10m.
anya: observability: expose tenant.burst_remaining, tenant.burst_used, tenant.fallback_count in Console and attach commit_tier tag on traces.
tereza: pilot asks: can we provide a temporary top-up of burst for testing (7 days)? customers want that.
anya: agree. pilot flow: +50% burst for 7 days, monitor metrics, no billing for trial top-ups.
mike: dev work: tenant table migration + routing flag + prewarm flag. estimate 2-3 sprints.
oliver: ops: add pager when fallback >5% requests for 10m and auto-notify account owner. ops-bot: scheduled canary for reserve-routing-v1 tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
anya: launch checklist draft: API + DB migration, Console panels, chaos test for fallback, pilot with 3 customers, pricing docs + invoice examples, SLO appendix per tier.
tereza: i'll prepare one-pager and procurement sheet.
anya: i'll spin up an RFC from this thread and tag owners. reactions please if OK.
mike: +1
tereza: +1
oliver: +1
ops-bot: acknowledged: canary scheduled.
